cohort: The study included 246 mothers who had recently given birth at a selected urban district hospital in Kigali, Rwanda, and were still on the hospital premises after discharge.
finding: The study found a high prevalence (67.48%) of disrespect and abuse towards women during labor and childbirth, with abandonment, undignified care, and lack of information on care being the most prevalent forms.
cross-section timing: Immediately after recent childbirth, while mothers were still on the hospital premises after discharge.
